scope: Read-only next P5 investigation during Indexing fixed-SQL verification; findings are not implemented or validated fixes.
live_entrypoints: IndexGenerationRefresher.buildAddedFiles -> same scalar builder; native HNSW/IVF_PQ/DISK_ANN/BM25 use DurableIndexBuildService

findings.finding: One ownerId per coordinator, but release and heartbeat omit it. Heartbeat failure is logged and build continues. Claim lifetime ends before publication callback.
findings.required_review: Unique attempt ownership; loss/unknown result semantics; final publication authority remains authoritative.

findings.finding: claimBuild defaults true; release/heartbeat no-op; expiry defaults zero. Concrete PostgreSQL implementation exists; expireStaleBuilds has no production caller.
findings.required_review: Separate required capability port; no success-shaped defaults. Establish recovery/fencing before wiring expiry.

findings.finding: Descriptor BUILDING timeout uses updatedAt CAS and optional leadership; does not examine build-claim heartbeat.
findings.required_review: Single recovery owner and atomic generation fencing; active build cannot publish after recovered generation authority is lost.

findings.finding: cancelledIndexes is keyed only by indexId; a new submit removes cancellation. Loop break returns COMPLETED with successful count and zero failures. DDL completion publishes successCount without original expected file count.
findings.required_review: Attempt-scoped cancellation and explicit terminal outcome; no partial build publication. Reproduce with deterministic barriers before changing behavior.

findings.finding: Single/batch mapping INSERT does not take descriptor/claim fence. Publication separately locks descriptor then reads mappings.
findings.required_review: Test competing late writes/publication; keep one atomic publication owner and make committed membership immutable.

findings.finding: Scalar artifact path is deterministic per index generation/data file and does not include producer attempt; output stream overwrite/conditional creation semantics are not expressed by the FileSystemAccessor contract.
findings.required_review: Do not enable expiring claim takeover without attempt-separated object paths or equivalent fenced immutable writes; preserve published objects under late old producer completion.
